sections.voiceover: The Iguazú Falls, spanning over a mile, recently surged to six times their normal volume.
But could Iguazú National Park handle the Iguazú River surging at such dangerous levels?
But a Super El Niño weather event brought heavy rains, forcing the park's total closure.
National park authorities in Argentina closed Iguazú National Park on October 12, 2026. The Iguazú River hit 6 times its normal flow rate during this Super El Niño event.
This October 2026 event forced the temporary closure of the entire Iguazú Falls complex.
